events.title: Meditation Free Community Event
events.description: Step away from the noise and into shared stillness. Each week, a different skilled practitioner brings a unique tone, intention, and insight to our meditation experience. To honor the peaceful environment, doors close promptly at 7:05 p.m. Please arrive early and allow extra time for parking. Our practitioners graciously take love donations and they are warmly appreciated. If you would like to shop, we invite you to do so before or after the session. Thank you for honoring our shared space.

events.title: Reiki with Rose Using the Energies of the Ankh & Archangels
events.description: Ankh Life Force Alignment Those who know Rose know that the spaces she creates are unlike any other. There is a quiet reverence, a sense of peace, and a palpable sacredness that begins the moment you enter the room. This next evolution of her practice is an invitation to experience the gifts of her journey—and perhaps awaken something that has always been waiting within you. After a profound journey through Egypt, Rose returned home with a deepened connection to her healing work. Immersed in the energy of ancient temples & pyramids, timeless spiritual traditions, and the enduring symbolism of the Ankh—the Key of Life—she came home carrying something that is difficult to put into words. Some experiences are learned. Others are remembered. The wisdom, presence, and sacredness Rose encountered have naturally woven themselves into the healing practice she has lovingly cultivated for years. Through Reiki, crystals, tuning forks, healing sound, sacred oils, and the symbolism of the Ankh, she creates a deeply intentional space where healing is invited, balance is restored, and the spirit is gently supported.

events.title: Aura Imaging & Chakra Balancing
events.description: Aura Imaging offers a fascinating visual snapshot of your energy field, revealing insights into your emotional, mental, and spiritual state. Through this process, you’ll see your aura and chakra balance displayed in real time, giving you a deeper understanding of what may be influencing how you feel and move through your life. Each session includes a detailed interpretation, explaining what the colors and patterns represent and how they connect to your current energy. This is a powerful tool for clarity, awareness, and alignment. Aura Imaging is available as a 30-minute session. If you would like to incorporate Reiki for deeper energetic support and integration, please select a 60-minute session. When booking, please choose your session length accordingly. Your experience will be guided and customized during your appointment.

events.title: Tarot with Adie
events.description: With a lifetime devoted to the Tarot, Adie offers readings that are thoughtful, precise, and deeply insightful. 30 minutes for clarity | 60 minutes for depth. An elevated experience designed to bring focus and refined understanding.

events.title: Tai Chi Gung with Sherry Gurley
events.description: Tai Chi Gung with Sherry Gurley Discover a gentle yet powerful practice designed to restore balance, strengthen the body, and quiet the mind. Guided by Sherry Gurley, Certified Tai Chi Gung Instructor and Quantum Biofeedback Practitioner, this class combines slow, flowing movements with intentional breath and energy awareness. Suitable for all experience levels and adaptable for both sitting and standing, Tai Chi Gung can help improve strength, flexibility, balance, and overall well-being. Many students find that regular practice supports better sleep, reduces stress, and creates a deeper sense of calm and connection. In this class you may experience: • Increased energy and vitality • Improved balance and body awareness • Greater relaxation and inner peace • A renewed sense of strength and well-being • A deeper connection to yourself and your spiritual path Whether you are seeking better health, more peace, or simply a beautiful way to reconnect with yourself, this class offers a welcoming space to slow down, breathe, and restore.

events.title: Reiki with Renee Free Community Appointments (love Donations)
events.description: Reiki with Renee Set aside some time to rest, breathe, and reconnect with yourself during a Reiki session with Renee. A Reiki Master Teacher trained in Usui Reiki and Holy Fire® Reiki, Renee brings a kind heart, intuitive presence, and gentle energy to every session. She is a longtime member of the Sacred Ground community who is known for her warmth, curiosity, and dedication to continued spiritual learning. Renee is currently offering sessions for love donations as she builds her practice and completes additional hands-on experience. This makes Reiki available to those who may not otherwise have access while giving Renee the opportunity to deepen her work as a practitioner. No previous Reiki experience is necessary. Simply arrive as you are, wearing comfortable clothing and with an open mind. Payment: Love donation Location: Sacred Ground Appointments: Advance booking recommended

events.title: Quantum Shift: From Insight to Transformation
events.description: What if you could consciously shift the patterns shaping your reality? Choose something within yourself you’re ready to transform and explore quantum principles, energy practices, and guided techniques designed to help you release old patterns, shift your energy, and align with new possibilities. Led by Eve Muir-Wilson, HTP, RM, Energy Alignment Specialist and Metaphysical Educator, who blends intuitive energy healing, quantum practices, and more than 30 years of experience guiding personal growth and transformation. No previous experience with quantum concepts or practices is needed. All are welcome.

events.title: Tina’s Intuitive Tarot, Runes & Reiki Experience
events.description: Every session with Tina is uniquely guided by your needs, intentions, and the energy of the moment. Whether you are seeking clarity through Tarot, insight from the ancient wisdom of the Runes, healing through Reiki, or a personalized blend of all three, Tina creates a customized experience designed to support your journey. Some clients come with specific questions and receive intuitive guidance through Tarot and Rune readings. Others seek relaxation, energetic balance, and renewal through Reiki. Many choose a combination of modalities, allowing insight and healing to work together in a deeply meaningful way. Available in 30 or 60-minute sessions, each appointment is thoughtfully tailored to provide the guidance, perspective, and energetic support that best serves you. Whether you’re navigating a life transition, seeking answers, or simply looking to reconnect with yourself, Tina offers a welcoming space for exploration, healing, and discovery.

events.title: Lisa Maria Intuitive Tarot
events.description: With Lisa Maria at Sacred Ground — Intuitive Tarot on Fridays. Intuitive Tarot opens a space of reflection and clarity. The cards—rich with symbolic wisdom—offer insight into your present moment and illuminate possibilities ahead. Lisa Maria’s calm, intuitive presence lets the messages unfold naturally, clear and easy to connect with. Thirty-minute sessions are ideal for one or two focused questions; sixty-minute sessions allow a deeper exploration of what is shifting. Friday hours: 1:00–6:00 PM Central. Book Intuitive Tarot on her booking page.

events.title: ”Awaken Your Intuition: Exploring Oracle and Tarot in a Sacred Space” With Lisa Maria
events.description: This workshop is all about awakening your intuition, integrating card wisdom into daily life, and tapping into a vibrant community of like-minded individuals. Whether you’re a beginner or a returning participant, each class is designed to meet you where you are and expand your intuitive practice. Don’t have a deck? No worries! Extra decks will be available for you to explore. Start the new year with intention and clarity! Each session is a chance to set meaningful goals, manifest your desires, and align with your highest-self as you grow your intuitive practice. Mark your calendar! This inspiring workshop happens every first Friday of the month, so there’s always a new opportunity to awaken, connect, and discover. Reserve your spot today! Let’s awaken intuition together and enrich our personal journeys, making this year your most intuitive and inspired yet.

events.title: Tarot with Adie

events.title: An Intuitive Art Experience: Whispers of Angelic Guidance With Melissa
events.description: Whispers of Angelic Guidance Price $55. Supplies included. No experience necessary. An intuitive and spiritually inspired art experience designed to help you slow down, connect within, and welcome the angelic presence that may be supporting you on your journey at this time. Through gentle guidance, reflection, and creativity, you’ll be invited to discover and create your own angel—one that represents the energy, message, comfort, or guidance you are being called to receive right now. Your angel doesn’t need to look a certain way. It will emerge through your own intuition, colors, symbols, and imagination. No art experience is needed. This isn’t about creating a “perfect” painting—it’s about giving yourself permission to explore, express, and listen inwardly. Come as you are, trust the process, and allow your angel to reveal itself to you. Create what you feel. Receive what you need. Trust the guidance that unfolds.

events.title: Soul Guidance Through Channeled Poetry with Lisa Seyring
events.description: We warmly welcome Lisa Seyring as a new practitioner at Sacred Ground, now offering 30-minute intuitive poem readings. Step into a gentle, heart-centered experience where divine guidance is shared through the healing power of spontaneous poetry. In these 30-minute sessions, Lisa channels insightful messages in the form of a personalized poem, created in the moment just for you. These sacred words carry a unique energetic vibration designed to help you reconnect with your inner truth, align with the wisdom of your heart, and experience a deeper sense of coherence with Love. Each reading offers clarity, comfort, and soulful perspective — a beautiful invitation to listen beyond the mind and receive guidance from within. BIO: Lisa Seyring is devoted to giving voice to the profound wisdom of the heart. With a natural gift for insight, she supports individuals in moving beyond mental noise and into expanded heart awareness. Through intuitive perception and soul-centered guidance, Lisa helps clients shift perspective and see life through a more compassionate and empowered lens. Her sessions often include channeled poetic messages and vocal healing transmissions that gently illuminate emotional patterns and long-held beliefs. Drawing on her studies in metaphysics and various healing modalities, Lisa meets both the analytical mind and the emotional body with sensitivity and depth. By guiding clients through an inner “archeological” exploration of emotions, Lisa helps release stagnant energy and create space for new foundations rooted in truth and self-love. As an intuitive poet, she crafts healing medicine through words — offering insight, freedom, and renewed joy. It is her honor to support others in awakening to the infinite wisdom that lives within their own hearts.

Thirty-minute sessions are ideal for one or two focused questions; sixty-minute sessions allow a deeper exploration of what is shifting. Somatic Healing is a one-hour, fully clothed session using tuning forks, intuitive awareness, and somatic listening within the biofield. Lisa Maria gently guides stagnant or overactive energy back toward balance, flow, and coherence. events.title: Beyond the Physical: Intuitive Mediumship With Lori
events.description: Mediumship is a practice centered around connection, remembrance, and the belief that the bonds of love continue even after someone has passed. These private mediumship sessions are designed for individuals who would like the opportunity to connect with loved ones who have passed away in a peaceful, supportive, and grounded environment. Each 60-minute session begins with a few moments of grounding and energetic clearing, allowing you to settle into the space, quiet the outside world, and become present for the experience. From there, the medium will open to positive, loving spiritual energy and allow the connection to unfold naturally. Mediumship is not about forcing a particular person to appear or controlling exactly what comes through. Instead, the medium serves as a bridge, remaining receptive to impressions, feelings, images, memories, personalities, symbols, or messages that may arise during the session. When a connection is made, the intention is to provide meaningful information that helps you recognize and understand the loved one who may be coming forward. For many people, a mediumship session can be an opportunity for remembrance, reassurance, reflection, and even healing. Sometimes the most meaningful moments are found in small details—a familiar personality trait, a shared memory, a phrase, or a feeling that brings someone you love close to your heart again. The final 5–10 minutes of the session are reserved for debriefing, reflection, and questions. This gives you time to process what came through, talk about the experience, and leave feeling grounded and supported. Every session is unique, just as every relationship is unique. While a specific connection or message can never be guaranteed, each session is approached with respect, compassion, positive intention, and an open heart.

events.title: Amber | Customized Therapeutic Massage Sessions
events.description: Amber offers a deeply restorative, results-driven massage experience tailored to meet your body exactly where it is. Blending Swedish, Thai, Deep Tissue, and Warm Bamboo techniques, each session is intuitively customized—designed to release tension, improve mobility, and bring your body back into balance. Her work not only addresses physical tension, but can also support the release of stored stress and trauma held within the body—helping clients feel more grounded, at ease, and reconnected. Each session is created with care, skill, and presence—leaving clients feeling restored, lighter, and profoundly relieved. 30-minute chair sessions ($60) are ideal for quick relief—perfect for neck, shoulders, and upper back tension. 45-minute sessions ($90) allow for more focused therapeutic work, addressing specific areas of tightness or stress. 60-minute sessions ($125) offer a full-body experience, combining relaxation and targeted muscle release. 90-minute sessions ($166) provide the most comprehensive treatment—supporting deeper release, full-body integration, and lasting results. When booking, please select your session length. Your massage style and focus will be customized during your appointment.
